speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Health considering that gender bias for Pre-implantation Genetic Screening (PGS) can now be blinded, whether the Ministry will consider permitting women with recurrent miscarriages or a history of infertility to seek PGS in Singapore.

speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider permitting Pre-implantation Genetic Screening to improve the chances of healthy live births, subject to strict controls, such as banning sex selection and use for other non-medical reasons.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Page: 8 MOH will consult stakeholders and the public to gather views.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I just ask her if there is any criteria for this trial that is going to be carried out at NUH for people that want to participate in this trial?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: The eligibility criteria for people to participate in this trial as well as all the other details, such as funding and so on, are being worked out and will be available closer to the date of commencement.
